whatsappMessage:
Hi Ram Dental Clinic team,

I noticed your clinic has solid 4.2★ reviews on Exhibition Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new patient appointment inquiries.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, treatments list, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ramdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ram Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp appointment booking, and your Exhibition Road location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
